name: Architecture Decision Checkpoint
scope: Documentation only — no new code, no new timing runs

phase24r_findings.root_cause: ggml_mul_mat requires [M,K] layout. Sidecar decodes to [K,M]. Transpose required but structurally incompatible with GGML tensor model.
phase24r_findings.closed_reason: physical transposition 90MB per run would erase efficiency

plausible_future_paths.label: A
plausible_future_paths.name: Native-layout sidecar experiment
plausible_future_paths.description: Generate separate [M,K] sidecar for direct ggml_mul_mat compatibility
plausible_future_paths.risk: decoded f32 90MB may still be slower than native Q4_K

plausible_future_paths.label: B
plausible_future_paths.name: True GGML backend op
plausible_future_paths.description: Real ggml_backend kernel instead of custom op wrapper

plausible_future_paths.label: C
plausible_future_paths.name: Keep PRT as representation/compression path
plausible_future_paths.description: Useful for canonical sidecar research, not speed path

plausible_future_paths.label: D
plausible_future_paths.name: Speculative decoding integration
plausible_future_paths.description: Batching only for multiple accepted tokens
plausible_future_paths.risk: not relevant for current PRT scope

plausible_future_paths.label: E
plausible_future_paths.name: Multi-layer PRT after overhead fixed
plausible_future_paths.description: Wait until per-layer overhead is resolved

plausible_future_paths.label: F
plausible_future_paths.name: Accept + document as-is
plausible_future_paths.description: PRT overhead ~1.08s documented, stop unless specific use case

recommended_next.description: Phase 24T: Native-layout sidecar feasibility paper/probe design only. Write a clear design doc before implementing.
recommended_next.alt_description: Phase 24T: Generate 3B [M,K] layout sidecar and test ggml_mul_mat compatibility. Non-trivial re-extraction + validation effort.
recommended_next.stop_description: Preserve canonical INT8 sidecar as research artifact. PRT overhead ~1.08s known. Stop unless specific use case emerges.
